Theorem
[Short time existence---closed manifolds] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0384 1. appD:D.1\group Ricci Flow Existence

If $(\mathcal M^n,g_0)$ is a smooth closed Riemannian manifold, there is a unique smooth Ricci flow $g(t)$, $t\in [0,T)$, with $g(0)=g_0$.
